summary:
**MISSION: BEYOND** is an interactive space exploration and mission design experience that brings lunar exploration and space science into a playable 3D environment.

Players can explore a lunar surface built using real elevation measurements derived from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) data. The project incorporates lunar terrain exploration, rover movement and a simulated lunar landing experience, alongside an Artemis mission visualisation and an interactive black-hole science experience.

Our goal is to make space exploration more accessible and engaging by connecting real planetary science with interactive experiences. We distinguish NASA-derived terrain data from educational gameplay simulations, allowing users to explore the Moon while learning about the challenges and science behind space missions.
details:
MISSION: BEYOND — Project Details

MISSION: BEYOND is an interactive 3D space exploration experience developed for the Space Mission Design Game challenge. It combines space mission visualisation, lunar exploration and educational simulations in an accessible browser-based environment.

Lunar exploration: The Lunar Frontier experience uses a processed elevation grid derived from NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter (LRO) Lunar Orbiter Laser Altimeter (LOLA) data. This real elevation information drives the generated lunar terrain. Users can explore the environment and experience rover movement.

Lunar landing simulation: The mission simulation incorporates NASA LOLA-derived terrain sampling into a simplified educational landing experience. The flight dynamics are simulated rather than presented as operational spacecraft guidance.

Space exploration: The project also features an Artemis mission visualisation and an interactive black-hole science experience, combining 3D environments, animations and interactive elements to encourage exploration and learning.

Our intention is to make complex space science more approachable through direct interaction rather than passive information displays. We distinguish real NASA-derived elevation measurements from simplified educational simulations.

Technologies used: React, TypeScript, Three.js, React Three Fiber, React Three Drei, React Three Postprocessing, Vite and GLSL shaders.

The project was developed as a responsive web experience, with a focus on immersive visuals, interactive exploration and communicating the relationship between real scientific data and simulated mission experiences.
